summary: A small, open, fully described smartwatch: a round colour display, motion and heart-rate sensing, haptic alerts and Bluetooth LE to a phone.
features: Step counting, wrist-raise wake and heart rate on demand
Haptic alerts, and two buttons on the case side
A 200 mAh LiPo cell charged from USB-C; target of 5 days or more of typical use
A printed case for a standard 22 mm two-piece strap; splash resistant, no ingress rating claimed

functions.text: Show time, notifications and sensor readings on a 1.28-inch round 240×240 colour display
Count steps and detect wrist raise to wake the display
Measure heart rate (and SpO2 as a raw signal, not a medical value) on demand and periodically
functions.by: MAX30102 through a window in the back cover

functions.text: Exchange data with a phone over Bluetooth LE
Charge from USB-C, and update firmware over USB
Two buttons on the case side: wake/select and back
